turnaround_reason: Charter fell ~58% from its 52-week high, including a record -25.5% single session in April 2026, on accelerating broadband subscriber losses (120k in Q1, 172k cited) amid fixed-wireless and fiber competition. The bull case is that the just-closed Cox acquisition plus mobile growth and heavy FCF stabilize units at a deeply discounted valuation.
bullish_points: Highly cash-generative cable model with 23.5% operating margin and 9% net margin even through the sub declines
Cox acquisition (~$34.5B) expected to close mid-to-late August 2026; management frames it as improving internet performance and unit growth
Mobile line growth (~12M lines cited) is a real, growing convergence lever that reduces churn
Street mean target implies large upside from a washed-out price; sentiment is maximally bearish
Basing setup after a historic drawdown — much of the bad news is arguably priced
bearish_points: Enormous leverage: ~$96.7B total debt against a $20B equity cap; equity is a thin slice of a $119B EV, so small EBITDA changes swing the stock hard
Broadband losses are still widening quarter over quarter — the core secular threat (fiber overbuild + FWA) is not yet stabilized
Cox integration is large and execution-heavy; synergy timing and added debt are risks
Weaker profit outlook flagged alongside the sub losses
Dossier technicals null; 'basing' is unconfirmed and could re-break on another weak print
catalyst: Cox deal close and first combined-entity subscriber/guidance updates showing broadband trends stabilizing
catalyst_timing: 2H 2026 (deal close already underway) and Q3/Q4 2026 earnings
suggested_trade: Small starter spot only; this is a levered value/turnaround, size for the possibility of continued sub bleed
key_risk: Broadband subscriber losses keep accelerating post-Cox, compressing EBITDA against the huge debt load
would_skip_if: Next print shows broadband losses worsening or Cox integration guidance disappoints
note: Existing deep-dive research note already present at data/research/CHTR.md; not redone.
